adoption: Review mission fit, adapt, test one suitable surface, then promote deliberately.

candidates.title: Show the result beside the action
candidates.lesson: Use explicit saving, saved, or retry feedback beside the control; confirm persistence before claiming success.
candidates.missionAdapter: Pilot in quotes and invoices; test failed saves and navigation before expanding.

candidates.title: Keep controls with the work
candidates.lesson: Keep essential tools and the next action visible; reduce decoration before reducing usable control sizes.
candidates.missionAdapter: Pilot in the Carvewright drawing workspace; retain access to job details and allow necessary document scrolling.

candidates.title: Separate the tool from the input device
candidates.lesson: A finger or Pencil chooses an input device; Draw, Shapes and Select define the action. Switching devices must not silently choose a shape.
candidates.missionAdapter: Review canvas tools only. Recheck menu dismissal, pen-to-finger transitions and undo.

candidates.title: Finish in the context of the job
candidates.lesson: Completion should explain what was completed and offer the relevant next step, while preserving a way back.
candidates.missionAdapter: Review each workflow separately: a flight lands; an invoice confirms its saved state; a design returns to its own job.

candidates.title: Give animation a clear lifetime
candidates.lesson: Use readable pacing, reduced-motion support, hidden-tab pause and immediate exit. Cancel callbacks when leaving a view.
candidates.missionAdapter: Use subtle feedback where business work benefits; never delay a user action for a celebration.

candidates.title: Keep playful variety in learning activities
candidates.lesson: Vary solvable number patterns and celebrate flight completion with a short firework display.
candidates.missionAdapter: Wonderwake only by default. Do not automatically add game rewards, fireworks or random choices to business workflows.
